title_voiceover: Welcome to this board review on transfusion medicine. Today we'll cover the fundamentals of blood typing, the important pretransfusion testing procedures, and dive into two key areas: Coombs' testing and autoimmune hemolytic anemia, including special considerations for AIHA transfusions. We'll also discuss how certain monoclonal antibody drugs like anti-CD38 and anti-CD47 can interfere with pretransfusion testing.
